tagline: Sprint down a corridor over three launch pads that fling you through three gates hanging in the air.
overview:
Skyhook Sprint is a tiny first-person jump-pad course, built as a quick physics experiment. A narrow corridor holds three cyan launch pads in a row, and above the floor just past each pad hangs a yellow gate bar.

Sprint forward: each pad hurls you into the air, and you need to pass through each gate as you fly. The gates disappear as you pass them. Fly through all three to win. A straight sprint does it in about two seconds; the challenge is not overshooting or drifting to the side, and you can steer a little in mid-air.
story: A skyhook training lane on a rooftop: three launch pads, three gates hanging in the air and a runner who has to thread all of them in a single sprint, without slowing down or drifting off line.
goal: Fly through all three gates (GATES 3): VICTORY. There is no way to lose.
rules: Running onto a cyan pad launches you upward and forward.
Each yellow gate counts when you pass through it in the air; it then disappears.

controls.action: Look, and steer a little while in the air

characters.name: Launch pads
characters.description: Three cyan squares on the floor, one after another.

characters.name: Gates
characters.description: Yellow bars hanging in the air just past each pad.

tips: Hold sprint and forward the whole way and keep your view straight down the corridor.
ROUND, the bat and the health bar on screen belong to the engine's default player and do nothing here.
